$comment: COMMITTED STATE — the published URL surface. Read the URL contract before editing.
`festivals[key].stages` records every stage slug that has ever been served at
https://stagetimes.app/<key>/<stage>.ics. The build APPENDS to this list and never removes.
If a slug listed here is missing from the YAML the build refuses to run, because that URL is
still being polled by every subscriber who ever tapped it and no redirect will save them.
`publishedAt` is the revision stamp for this publish. Bump it whenever you change a data file;
it becomes DTSTAMP / LAST-MODIFIED on every event the build touches and `lastUpdated` in feeds.json.
It exists so the build never reads the wall clock — output must be byte-identical across runs.
NOTE: `festivals` is intentionally empty. Nothing has been deployed to the production apex yet,
so no URL is being polled by anyone and gate 4 has nothing to protect. The build appends the
stage slugs on the first production build; from that moment they are frozen forever.
